name: Securities Regulatory Details
definition: Information related to order and required for regulatory purposes.

OrderRestrictions.name: Order Restrictions
OrderRestrictions.definition: Classification and restrictions linked to an order (for regulatory purpose).

BrokerSolicitedTrade.name: Broker Solicited Trade
BrokerSolicitedTrade.definition: Indicates whether the trading party has suggested to his client to buy/sell a financial instrument or whether the investor acts on its own without advice from its trading party.

RelatedOrder.name: Related Order
RelatedOrder.definition: Order for which legal parameters are provided.
